verdict.rationale: HCP Terraform's policy enforcement documents policies as rules for Terraform runs that check plans against security rules and best practices, and results can be viewed and overridden in the workspace UI, which implies runs are gated before apply. Policies can also be published and consumed via the public Registry. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that failing policies block the apply (enforcement levels), details of the policy languages and frameworks, confirmation that this works in the open-source CLI rather than only in HCP Terraform, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
